title: The $19K Gift Trick Rich Families Use Tax-Free
hook: Every year wealthy families legally hand their kids $19,000 completely tax-free — and 95% of Americans have no idea this rule exists in the tax code right now.
angle: Most people think estate planning only happens after death. The annual gift tax exclusion lets you transfer wealth every year while alive — zero taxes, zero paperwork — and it compounds massively over time.
audience: Middle-to-high income earners ages 35-65 who want to pass wealth to children or grandchildren without an estate tax hit
